text: An agent is an LLM configured with instructions, tools, handoffs, guardrails, and structured outputs
quote: An agent is a large language model (LLM) configured with instructions, tools, and optional runtime behavior such as handoffs, guardrails, and structured outputs.

text: Any Python function can be wrapped as a callable tool for an agent
quote: FunctionTool instances: wrap any Python function as a tool.

text: Function tools get automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation
quote: Function tools: Turn any Python function into a tool with automatic schema generation and Pydantic-powered validation.

text: Agents can hand off tasks to other specialized agents
quote: Handoffs allow an agent to delegate tasks to another agent. This is particularly useful in scenarios where different agents specialize in distinct areas.

text: Guardrails let you run validation/safety checks on input and output in parallel with agent execution
quote: Guardrails: Run input validation and safety checks in parallel with agent execution, and fail fast when checks do not pass.

text: You can subscribe to streaming updates of an agent run for progress and partial responses
quote: Streaming lets you subscribe to updates of the agent run as it proceeds. This can be useful for showing the end-user progress updates and partial responses.

text: Agents can be run via Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), or Runner.run_streamed()
quote: You can run agents via the Runner class. You have 3 options: Runner.run(), Runner.run_sync(), Runner.run_streamed()

text: Built-in session memory automatically maintains conversation history across multiple agent runs
quote: The Agents SDK provides built-in session memory to automatically maintain conversation history across multiple agent runs, eliminating the need to manually handle `.to_input_list()` between turns.

text: Built-in tracing records LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and custom events during a run
quote: The Agents SDK includes built-in tracing, collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.

text: The Traces dashboard lets you debug, visualize, and monitor agent workflows during development and production

text: Supports multiple MCP transports so agents can use filesystem, HTTP, or connector-backed MCP tool servers
quote: The Agents Python SDK understands multiple MCP transports. This lets you reuse existing MCP servers or build your own to expose filesystem, HTTP, or connector backed tools to an agent.

text: When a tool call needs approval, the SDK pauses the run, returns interruptions, and resumes later from the saved RunState
quote: When a tool call requires approval, the SDK pauses the run, returns interruptions, and lets you resume later from the same RunState.

text: Sandbox agents run inside isolated workspaces with manifest-defined files and resumable sandbox sessions
quote: Sandbox agents: Run specialists inside real isolated workspaces. Sandbox agents support manifest-defined files, sandbox client selection, and resumable sandbox sessions.

text: Agents can be exposed as callable tools for other agents without a full handoff
quote: Agents as tools: expose an agent as a callable tool without a full handoff.

text: Supports OpenAI-managed hosted tools including web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP, and image generation
quote: Use OpenAI-managed tools (web search, file search, code interpreter, hosted MCP, image generation)

text: You can set a default model for all agents via the OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL environment variable
quote: if you want to consistently use a specific model for all agents that do not set a custom model, set the `OPENAI_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable before running your agents.

text: The SDK is provider-agnostic, supporting OpenAI's Responses and Chat Completions APIs plus 100+ other LLMs
quote: It is provider-agnostic, supporting the OpenAI Responses and Chat Completions APIs, as well as 100+ other LLMs.

text: Sandbox execution supports isolated filesystem workspaces, shell commands, file editing, snapshots, and persisted sandbox session state
quote: Sandbox execution: Run agents with isolated filesystem workspaces, shell commands, file editing, snapshots, and sandbox session state when the work needs a workspace.

text: WebSearchTool lets an agent search the web
quote: The WebSearchTool lets an agent search the web.

text: Built-in tools include WebSearchTool, FileSearchTool for vector store retrieval, and CodeInterpreterTool for sandboxed code execution

text: Voice agents combine speech-to-text, an agent workflow, and text-to-speech into voice pipelines
quote: Voice agents: Build voice pipelines that combine speech-to-text, an agent workflow, and text-to-speech.

text: RealtimeAgent/RealtimeSession automatically connect microphone and audio output in the browser via WebRTC
quote: RealtimeAgent, RealtimeSession... Automatically connects your microphone and audio output in the browser via WebRTC.

text: Voice agents support low-latency spoken interactions with tools, guardrails, handoffs, and conversation history
quote: Voice agents, which support low-latency spoken interactions with tools, guardrails, handoffs, and conversation history
